title: Real-Variable Theory of Hardy--Lorentz Spaces on Quasi-Ultrametric Spaces of Homogeneous Type with Reverse-Doubling Property
summary: Let $(X,\mathbf{q},μ)$ be an ultra-RD-space with upper dimension $n\in(0,\infty)$; i.e., it is a quasi-ultrametric space of homogeneous type whose measure $μ$ satisfies an additional reverse doubling property. Let $\mathrm{ind\,}(X,\mathbf{q})\in(0,\infty]$ denote its lower smoothness index, as introduced by Mitrea et al. In this monograph, the authors first construct a new approximation of the identity on quasi-ultrametric spaces of homogeneous type, achieving a maximal degree of smoothness $0<\varepsilon\preceq\mathrm{ind\,}(X,\mathbf{q})$.
